senses.gloss:
छल n. (-लं)
 1. Wickedness.
 2. Fraud, circumvention, trick, stratagem.
3. Design, device.
 E. छल to cut, अलच् affix, and the radical final
rejected.

छलन nf. (-नं-ना) Tricking, deceiving.
 E. छल nominal verb, णिच् and भावे
ल्युट् aff.

छलनापर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cunning, crafty, deceitful.
 E. छलना and पर ad-
dicted to.

छलयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Deceiving, cheating.
 E. छल nom. verb to
cheat, शतृ aff.

छलिन् m. (-ली) A cheat.
 E. छल, and इनि aff.

छल्ली f. (-ल्ली)
 1. Skin, bark, rind, &c.
 2. Offspring, posterity.
 3. A
spreading creeper.
 4. A kind of flower. E. See the preceding.
